brief: Prioritise the Langmere Common transformer for pre-event attention ahead of younger units in otherwise similar condition, as its advanced age reduces its margin against mechanical failure under thermal cycling [MG-023]. Where the unit cannot be attended before the forecast heat event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023]. Reduce permissible load for ambient conditions by 1.5 percent of rating for each degree of average ambient above 30 degrees, assessed over the preceding 24 hours [MG-021].
